purpose: Checked-in unittest module lists for flow-delivery validation. No arbitrary shell.
notes: full_suite uses python -m unittest discover via the runner's dedicated branch
focused_tests may fall back to the active queue entry focused_tests paths

Proportionate profiles: shared_navigation (flow-agnostic boundary), task_navigation (alias of focused_tests), detector and consequential (flow-declared in flow_profiles), and promotion (architecture + governance) reserve the heavy full_suite for cleanup or promotion
detector and consequential are flow-declared: a flow lists them under flow_profiles; there is no global default
